subject: statecore-mcp 1.0.0
why: SQLite, but it does not model records: a note lands inside one JSON state blob in DigestStateSnapshot.state rather than as a row of its own. That makes the two foreign-data probes meaningful (they test whether the server preserves a column and a table it does not know about when it rewrites that blob) and the size probe unanswerable, so no content column is declared and large_record reports UNKNOWN rather than inventing a verdict. The store is only local because the command carries --data pointing at the run's directory; without it the subject writes to ~/.statecore, which the triage run demonstrated by creating it.
